documents.evidence: Both connect the handling note to permission to uncover work, reachable storage to lifting difficulty, arrival dates to weekly follow-up, and drying the lid with the piece to finding the correct lid later. The damage note stays private and timely for the maker's repair decision, and the member can name a substitute contact during an absence.

Both give organizers dated chair counts, delayed drivers a reachable keyholder, and borrowers folded and stacked measurements for vehicle planning. Both isolate visibly tagged damaged chairs before delivery, leave a cleaning and inspection interval between bookings, and let a borrower delegate the return if the organizer leaves early.

Both use natural line breaks and intact names for quick reading, default captions for the opening words, and a whole muted interview review to find replies that lack context. Quotation attribution starts with the reading, the loop title orients midway arrivals, and the title and playback time let staff locate a reported mistake.

The whole-song fallback step, option to stay with a partner, and practice stopping and recovering the beat serve the same beginners in both versions. Both also explain group instruction about passing direction on a busy floor, storage off the floor for a clear path, and visible, accessible water for a break without finding the host.

Both reserve willing bakers' portions within advertised hours for after-work choice, provide bags and a pencil to distinguish slices at home, and use next-day serving tips to encourage trying unfamiliar loaves. Both welcome empty-handed neighbors with spare bread, involve families through drawing without touching samples, and seek the baker's destination choice before the crew distributes leftovers.

Both use an unfinished sketch near the front to encourage imperfect marks, a viewfinder to frame a manageable part of a border, and scrap paper for private trials. The plant location guides another visitor to the specimen, the seasonal shelf supports same-month comparisons across years, and quiet drawing before a tour allows silent observation in company.

Both link advance clothing instructions to how show shoes affect the hem, longer multiple-change appointments to avoiding delays, and a named travel-delay contact to reusing a schedule gap. Both let the fitter see the time while attending to the performer, require alteration readback while the costume is on, and record agreed priorities when sewing capacity is short.

Both move demonstrations away from active matches, use a door-facing sign to welcome an opponent, and provide a written list so visitors can sit and read during busy periods. Both have the two players settle takebacks before play, separate prolonged analysis from quiet boards, and suggest privately consulting the host to settle rules disputes.
